Apple today announced it will hold a special event next Tuesday (October 13) with the tagline "Welcome home".

Apple will unveil new Home products on October 13, first teased by Greg Joswiak

Apple will launch new products next Tuesday (October 13), a hint dropped in a teaser video by Greg Joswiak, Apple's Senior Vice President of Worldwide Marketing. Below is the video released by Joswiak.

The outside world expects Apple to launch multiple new Home products at this event, including:

In addition, the LG home accessories that leaked earlier are also expected to make their appearance next week, which according to reports were co-developed by Apple and LG.

Alongside Joswiak's date reveal, Apple has also sent out invitations to the press for a special "Apple Experience" event to be held at 9am (US Eastern Time) in Tribeca, New York.

Below is the invitation shown off by Marques Brownlee:

JP's top comment

Three products. I'm guessing three colors of the  Car: Space Gray, White, and another slightly different White.

Earlier this year when Apple launched the MacBook Neo, it held a similar "Apple Experience" event for the press. At that time, the product launch took the form of a physical unveiling following several days of press releases.

However, this time around, the outside world broadly expects all the new Home products to debut on the same day.

It remains unclear whether Apple will upload a full video introducing the new products at 9am US Eastern Time. We will continue to follow up with the latest news for our readers.

What products do you expect Apple to announce on October 13? Feel free to share with us in the comments below.
